newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank -no comment on DSL talk.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank -no comment on DSL talk.

text.p: Germany's Commerzbank AG on Monday declined comment on market talk that it had bought a stake in the state-controlled bank, Deutsche Siedlungs- und Landesrentenbank.

The "Czerwensky Intern" bourse newsletter said Commerzbank, the third-largest commercial bank in Germany, had bought a 10.5 percent stake in DSL from BHW, a diversified financial services group, and was negotiating over a second stake of some 10 percent.
"We do not comment on market rumours," a Commerzbank spokesman said.
BHW said last week that it had reduced its DSL stake to just above 10 percent from 20.6 percent. DSL is 52 percent state-owned.
BHW also said it had not sold the stake to Postbank AG, the postal bank due to be privatised next year and which is in co-operation talks with DSL.
